name: @fl03/harness-codex
description: Codex CLI adapter: consumes @fl03/compiler's `codex` emission target (skills/, hooks/hooks.json, shepherd.codex.toml -- no command surface, Codex has nowhere to put one) and maps the 8 shepherd roles onto Codex's two native primitives (explorer read-only, worker write-capable) via [agent_types], declaring the max_concurrent_children = 3 descendant cap and per-role reasoning_effort profiles.
